$comment: Machine index of the cross-language client matrix whose PROVIDER is the Go Items sample. `scenarios` names one test per proven scenario; `coverage` states, for every cell of the matrix and every scenario family, whether it is proven (`pass`), inapplicable with the rule that makes it so (`n/a`), or absent with the reason (`missing`). `test` is <file>:<test name>, relative to this project. Nothing here is evidence by itself: the tests it names are, and matrix_index_test.go checks that every reference resolves.

families.covers: anonymous, service credentials with expiry and refresh, forwarded user identity, api key, secondary credential, AND/OR without downgrade
success, schema, presence, bytes, exact numbers, declared retryability, unknown remote error, invalid response, redacted details
budgets, per attempt, cancellation and limits, idempotency, circuit; for streams admission, idle, queues, terminal, half-close, backpressure, heartbeat

W3C context and deadline from a real inbound context, spans and metrics without double counting, no secret, payload, query string or unbounded label, shutdown on both sides, connections released, late calls refused
